claim: At its Capital Markets Day, whose call is on Friday 27 November 2026 at 10:00 CET, Rheinmetall cuts its 2030 group sales target below the "around €50bn" set in November 2025.

runs.scenario: If the CMD presentation confirms “around €50bn” but the CFO states a €48bn group sales ambition on the call without explicitly replacing the target, both the YES and NO conditions are met. The criterion does not say which statement takes precedence.
runs.yes_requires: Between 00:00 on 26 November and 23:59 on 27 November 2026, Europe/Berlin time, Rheinmetall must announce a 2030 group sales target or ambition below €50bn in a press release, ad-hoc notice, Capital Markets Day presentation, or statement by its CEO or CFO on the CMD call. The midpoint decides for a range. “Around €50bn,” segment targets, order backlog, and withdrawal without a replacement figure d
runs.decided_by: Rheinmetall’s qualifying announcement, as shown on rheinmetall.com or reported by dpa-AFX, Reuters, Bloomberg, or Börsen-Zeitung.

runs.yes_requires: Between 26 November 2026 00:00 and 27 November 2026 23:59 CET, Rheinmetall must publish via press release, ad-hoc notice, Capital Markets Day presentation, or a statement by the CEO or CFO in the CMD call a 2030 group sales target or ambition that is strictly below €50bn (or a range with a midpoint strictly below €50bn).
runs.decided_by: Official publications on rheinmetall.com, CEO/CFO statements in the CMD call, or reporting by dpa-AFX, Reuters, Bloomberg, or Börsen-Zeitung.

runs.scenario: All listed sources report the same CMD statement that the 2030 group sales ambition is now 'at least €45bn', with no ceiling or second endpoint. One reader treats €45bn as a published target below €50bn (YES); the other finds no closed range to midpoint and no figure set strictly below €50bn, and also no confirmation of €50bn or more, so applies the no-qualifying-figure rule (NO).
runs.yes_requires: Between 26 Nov 2026 00:00 and 27 Nov 2026 23:59 Europe/Berlin, Rheinmetall publishes a 2030 group sales target or ambition below €50bn (closed-range midpoint if a range; segment or backlog figures do not count) in a press release, ad-hoc notice, CMD presentation, or CEO/CFO statement on the CMD call, as shown on rheinmetall.com or reported by dpa-AFX, Reuters, Bloomberg, or Börsen-Zeitung.
runs.decided_by: What rheinmetall.com shows, or what dpa-AFX, Reuters, Bloomberg, or Börsen-Zeitung report, about those Rheinmetall publications or CEO/CFO call statements; no separate adjudicator is named.
